title: Filipino Pork Skewers with Sour Marinade
description: Tender pork skewers marinated in a tangy sour mixture, grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine sour calamansi juice, garlic, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine pork cubes and marinade. Mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt to taste.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until pork is cooked through.
Transfer skewers to a plate and garnish with chopped cilantro.
